title: Final: mesh formats
sub: OBJ, STL, PLY, glTF, FBX, USD: test yourself
cards/0/task: A character has to move between programs without losses, but the format must be an open standard. Find it.
cards/1/q: Which format stores only triangles, with no color or units?
cards/1/explain: STL’s minimalism is both its strength and its weakness.
cards/2/q: Which PLY header line declares a color?
cards/2/explain: property uchar red is the red component of the vertex color.
cards/3/options/0: Everything is packed into one binary file
cards/4/q: In USD, layer A is above layer B. Both set a color. Whose color wins?
cards/5/q: What can OBJ not do? Select all.
cards/5/explain: OBJ does have UVs: the vt lines.
cards/6/task: A red bar stool, without editing chair.usda.
cards/7/q: Why is FBX a standard for animation but not for the web?
cards/7/options/0: It is closed and built for exchange between programs, not for fast delivery to the screen
cards/7/explain: For the web there is glTF: open and ready to render.
cards/8/q: Which format has glTF almost replaced?
cards/8/explain: Both come from Khronos; glTF does the same job more simply and faster.
